name: Medium - Project: Renovating my kitchen, need melamine for
customer_profile: Customer in Swaneville describing a project, needs help with product selection

messages.text: Hi, Renovating my kitchen, need melamine for cupboards. What boards do I need?
I'm in Swaneville. I think I need about 18 sheets of 16mm white melamine chipboard.
Can you give me a quote for that?
Sounds good. What's the next step?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should attempt to close the sale

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Project describer. AI should help with product selection, quote, and close.
